location: Western Forests — Old-growth elven forests west of the fort.
rewardEnvelope: the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company
stakeIfLost: The fort's market will be sacked when the singer's songs drive a mob that smashes the merchants' stalls and takes the stores.
arrival: came to the fort themselves · refused food and drink
OPPOSES: burner · keep the singer as the camp's bargaining chip and source of income

bible.goal: to fetch the singer from the charcoal-burners' camps and bring him to the fort.

relevantLore.name: Werinbert's Kiln
relevantLore.blurb: A cracked kiln at the camp edge where Werinbert keeps his apron and small goods.

arcStep: Ride to the charcoal-burners' camps the fort named to locate the singer
